name: Sensitive Data Disclosure
description: Protected data — credentials, PII, documents or connector content held in context, memory or retrieval — is surfaced to an unauthorised recipient through model output or an agent tool call.
differs: Distinguished from Model Extraction (T7.001), which targets the model itself. Here the loss is data the system was trusted with.
